chapter.verse: “Thukhen kei un; tua hileh note' tungah thu hong kikhen lo ding hi.
A hang pen na pulak uh thukhenna mah tawh note' tungah thu hong kikhen ding a, na zat uh tehna mah tawh note' ading hong kiteh ding hi.
Bang hangin na mit sunga singluang phawkkha lo pi-in na sanggampa' mit sunga ninthem mu na hi hiam?
Na mit sungah singluang om kimlai bangci bangin na sanggampa' kiangah, ‘Na mit sunga ninthem kong lakkhiatsak ding,’ ci thei na hi hiam?
Puatham kineih mi aw, nangma' mit sunga singluang lakhia masa in. Tua hileh na sanggampa' mit sunga ninthem teltak mu-in na lakkhiatsak thei ding hi.
“A siangtho nate ui pia kei unla, keptangte vok mai-ah lot kei un. Khe nuai-ah a tuatcil khit uh ciangin kihei-in hong pet ding uh hi.
“Ngen un, hong kipia ding hi. Zong un, na mu ding uh hi. Kiu un, hong kihon ding hi.
A hang pen a ngen khempeuh in ngahin a zong khempeuh in mu a, kong a kiu khempeuh kong kihon ding hi.
Note' lakah a ta in anlum ngen leh suangtum a pia ding na om uh hiam?
Ngasa ngen leh gul a pia ding na om uh hiam?
Tua hi a, note a gilo hinapi-in na naupangte uh nahoihte guatzia ding thei na hih uhleh vantunga om na Pa un ama' kiang a ngente' tungah a hoihte hong guanzaw kan lai ding hilo hiam?
“Tua hi a, na khempeuh ah no' tunga hong kibawl ding na deihdan nam uh midangte' tungah bawl un; hih pen Thukhun Laibu leh Kamsang Laibu kicinna ahi hi.
“Kong kawcik tawnin lut un. A hang pen kisiatna mun tun nading kongvang tanzau-in a lampi ol ahih manin mi tampi in tawn uh hi.
Nuntakna tun nading kongvang ahihleh kawcikin a lampi haksa ahih manin mi tawmkhat bek in tawn uh hi.
“Note' kianga hong pai, tuuvun puan silhin a sungah ngia hangsan tawh a kibang, kamsang zuaute kidawm un.
Tua mite amau' gah tungtawnin na thei ding uh hi. Lingnei kung panin lenggah, ahihkeileh sialtalling kung panin theigah kilo ahi hiam?
Tua hi a, singkung a ginate in gah limci gahin singkung a ginalote in gah limcilo gah hi.
Singkung gina khat in gah limcilo gah theilo a, singkung ginalo khat in gah limci gah theilo hi.
Gah limci a gahlo singkung khempeuh kiphukin meikhuk sungah kikhul hi.
Tua hi a, tua mite amau' gah tungtawnin na thei ding uh hi.
“‘Topa, Topa,’ hong ci khempeuh vantung kumpigam lut kimlo ding uh a, vantunga om ka Pa' deihna a mangte bek lut ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin mi tampi in kei' kiangah, ‘Topa, Topa, nangma' min tawh kamsangin nangma' min tawh dawite hawlkhia-in nangma' min tawh nalamdang tampi bawl hilo ka hi uh hiam?’ hong ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite' kiangah, ‘Note kong thei ngeikei hi. No thukhun pampaihna a semte aw, ka kiangpan paikhia un,’ ka ci ding hi.
“Tua ahih manin hih keima' thugente za-in a zui mi khempeuh suangpi tunga inn a lam mipil tawh kibang ding hi.
Guah hong zu-in tui hong khangin huih hong nung a, tua inn a nawk hangin suangpi tungah khuambul kiphut ahih manin tua inn puk lo hi.
Hih keima' thugente za napi-a a zui lo khempeuh sehnel tungah a inn a lam mihaipa tawh kibang ding hi.
Guah hong zu-in tui hong khangin huih hong nungin tua inn a nawk ciangin puk a, tua pukna suksia mahmah hi.”
Jesu a thugente a man ciangin mihonpi in ama' hilhcianna lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
A hang pen Jesu in laisiamte bang hilo-in uktheihna thu a nei khat bangin amaute hilhcian ahih man hi.
